title: 第2章 做人要低调
content_zh:
第一卷初临异世 第二章 做人要低调

刘枫把手里刚摘下来的红果，丢在嘴里咕噜的不住咬动，口齿不清的道,“真是倒霉，找了半天就只找到这么几个烂果。”

三下俩口把手中的红果吞进入肚，随手把果核丢在树丛里，用手指剔了剔牙缝，在身上那已经破烂得已经遮不住春guang的衣服上搽了搽，然后继续朝前赶路。

“妈的，刚才真TM的险，差点就成了那条狼的晚餐了，若被吃了，指不定现在是不是变成了一拓大便，给哪颗大树当肥料去了，哈哈，那头狼也是个SB，啧啧，也是少爷智商高，岂是一头畜生能够相比？”想到这里，刘枫狂妄的大笑起来，那嚣张的神情足以让人以为他是否打败了一头巨龙，而不是从一头连阶级都还入的魔兽口中狼狈的逃出升天。

不过，做人不能太狂妄，也不能太嚣张，在地球上某位大神也曾经说过：“做人莫装B，装B糟雷劈”。

虽然刘枫没有真的糟到雷劈，可貌似下场也强不到那里去？

风豹现在很生气，非常的生气，作为这一小片地区的老大，在外围的魔兽平时谁见着，不躲的远远的啊，可今天先是被几个果核砸在头上，又是被一阵刺耳的狂笑从chun梦中惊醒，在梦中，它的梦中情人已经答应了它的求偶，刚正屁颠屁颠的跑过去，准备做那伟大的传宗接代之事，那可恶的笑声就把美梦给打断了，这让它如何不气，如何不怒？

跳出树丛，凭借天生的嗅觉马上找到了这件事情的罪魁祸首，一个丑不拉几，而且还笑得傻不拉几的人类。。。。。

刘枫现在很悲哀，很想哭，“妈的，我怎么就这么背啊，随便丢几个果核都能砸出一头野兽，呜，在地球上每天买彩票，为什么连个安慰奖都从来没有得到过？”

大神教我做人要低调，莫装B，果然真是良言啊，诚不欺我啊。。。。。

风豹并不给正在为自己装B的行为后悔的刘枫机会，头一低，再一抬，一片肉眼可见的青色风刃朝刘枫疾速射去，刘枫连忙趴下身，风刃发出啸声从头顶上飘过，带起一阵凉风，射在了身后的树木上，大树“噶吱”的响了俩下，然后从中断了开去。

刘枫眼直了，特异功能？？？？魔兽？？？？？

爬起身来，转身就跑，妈的，这世界太危险了，还是地球安全啊。。。。

风豹看刘枫逃跑却并不着急，低下头，嘴中不断聚着风元素，猛的，抬头，一大卷风刃，疾射向正在连滚带爬的刘枫。

感到身后传来的劲风，刘枫不敢回头观看，双脚使了命的狂奔，可是腿再快也快不过风，身后的风刃越来越近，刘枫已经听到了身后的风啸声，后背突然一凉，衣服破了。

生死关头，刘枫头脑中一片空白，天地间仿佛安静了下来，身后的呼啸声也停止了，忽然脑海里深处似乎涌出了什么东西，而且似乎自动的启动了？

风豹得意的看着自己的杰作，这是它最强大的招数，“暴风刃”。这魔法可有和人类的四级魔法相媲美。

“暴风刃”离目标越来越近了，风豹嘴角泛起了残忍的微笑。

近了，越来越近了，就在“暴风刃”要将目标撕成碎片之时，那猎物忽然消失了，消失了？

风豹看着这离奇的情况，迷惑的甩了甩头，难道我的魔法升级了？威力变大了，把那个人类撕成了粉末？

不过没有答案，智商并不高的风豹只好把这次的失误归到了魔法突然变强了的原因上，至于为什么变强了么，那多半是那个人类长的太丑，又太嚣张，使得风元素也极其讨厌他的原因吧，管他呢，反正死都死了，回去继续睡觉吧。

话说刘枫当时脑海里的某种东西被启动了，然后，就感觉到周围的景象似乎变的模糊了起来，狂风“呼呼”的不断击打在脸颊上，这似乎是正在高速移动的象征？

猛的，刘枫清醒了过来，这的确是在高速跑动，可我怎么可能跑到这么快？

突然，前方百米远出现一颗巨树，虽然不知道以自己现在的速度撞上去是什么下场，可只要一想起，在地球上高速公路上相撞的汽车，刘枫就头皮发麻。

“停。。呕。。呕。下。。”刘枫一张嘴就被罐入了一肚子的狂风，只能在心底狂吼：“停下，快停下，我草你妈啊，给我停下来啊，劳资不想死啊。”

离巨树还有50米。。。40。。。20。。。10。。。

刘枫双眼大睁，惊骇之色布满了脸庞，就在离大树还有5米左右的时候，忽的，刘枫的身体顿了下来，可是由于极高速带来的惯性，身体摔到在地，接连打了好几个滚，然后一头撞在树干上，头一痛，眼前一黑，晕了过去，刘枫在昏迷前的一刹那脑中最后的念头就是“贼老天，玉皇大帝，如来佛祖，我草你们的仙人板板。”

就在刘枫昏迷不久后，丛林不远处“晰晰梭梭”的响起了脚步声，紧接着，一个轻脆得宛如风铃般的声音响起：“爷爷，快点，刚才风元素的波动就是在这边呢。”

“呵呵，乖孙别急，老头我身子骨可没你那么结实”一个苍老的声音紧接着也响了起来。

树枝摇动间，碧绿的叶子后面露出一张精致的小脸，美丽的蓝色大眼睛如俩颗蓝宝石般，调皮的闪动着，长长的睫毛忽闪忽闪的。

只见她从树枝后蹦着跳了出来，好奇的看着不远处躺在地上的刘枫，转头向身后娇声喊道：“爷爷，快来，这里有一个人呢，就是不知道是死是活耶。”

少女身后出现了一个老人，满脸的笑容，对着少女笑道，“走吧，我们过去看看。”

“呀，爷爷，你看他满身都是血呢。”少女捂着小嘴惊道。

老人皱着眉，看了看刘枫的伤口，道“是风造成的伤口，我想刚才的风元素波动多半跟他有关系吧，不过他的身体里没有斗气和魔法的波动啊？”

“呵呵，爷爷真笨，他既然没有斗气和魔法，身上又这么多风刃造成的伤口，说不定是遇到了死亡森林里的风系魔兽了呢。”少女皱着可爱的小鼻子对着老人娇声笑道。

“哈哈，乖孙女真聪明。”老头裂开大嘴笑道。

“那当然，我可是星蓝学院的圣生呢。”少女挺着胸口骄傲的说道。

听到星蓝学院的名字，老人眯着眼笑了，看着少女的目光多了几丝欣慰。

“怎么办呢？爷爷”少女嘟着红润的小嘴问道。

老人想了想，对少女道:“恩，先把他弄回家去吧，若把他就这样丢在这不管，他活不过今天晚上的。”

“爷爷心地真好。”少女蓝色的大眼睛弯成了美丽的月牙儿。

“哈哈，哈哈”听到少女的奉承，老人开心的笑了起来，额头上深深的皱纹，也敞开许多，似乎年轻了。。。。。。

Volume 1: First arrival in a different world Chapter 2: Be low-key

Liu Feng put the red fruit he had just picked in his hand and kept chewing it. He said inarticulately, "It's really unlucky. After searching for a long time, I only found these few rotten fruits."

After swallowing the red fruit in his hands, he threw the core into the bushes, picked the gap between his teeth with his fingers, wiped it on his clothes that were so tattered that they could no longer cover his spring hair, and then continued to move forward.

"Damn, it was so fucking dangerous just now. It almost became that wolf's dinner. If it was eaten, it might have turned into a pile of poop and been used as fertilizer for some big tree. Haha, that wolf is also a SB, tsk tsk, it's also Young Master Zhi.How can Shang Gao be compared to a beast?" Thinking of this, Liu Feng laughed arrogantly, and his arrogant expression was enough to make people think that he had defeated a giant dragon, instead of escaping from the mouth of a monster that had not even entered the class.

However, you should not be too arrogant or arrogant as a human being. A certain great god on earth once said: "As a human being, don't pretend to be B, as pretending to be B will cause lightning strikes."

Although Liu Feng was not really so bad that he was struck by lightning, it seemed that the outcome was not that bad?

Feng Bao is very angry now, very angry. As the boss of this small area, whoever sees the monsters in the periphery usually stays far away, but today, he was hit on the head by several fruit cores, and then was knocked out of Chunmeng by a burst of ear-piercing laughter.He woke up in a dream. In his dream, his dream lover had agreed to his courtship. He just ran over and was about to do the great thing of passing on the family line. That hateful laughter interrupted his sweet dream. How could he not be angry? How could he not be angry?

Jumping out of the bushes, he immediately found the culprit of this matter with his natural sense of smell, a human being who was extremely ugly and had a silly smile.....

Liu Feng is very sad now and wants to cry, "Damn, why do I carry it like this? Just throwing in a few fruit cores can smash out a beast. Wow, I buy lottery tickets every day on earth, why do I never get even a consolation prize?"

The great god taught me to be low-key and not to be pretentious. It was indeed a good advice. You are sincere and don’t deceive me.....

The wind leopard did not give Liu Feng, who was regretting his act of pretending, a chance. He lowered his head and then raised it, and a green blade of wind visible to the naked eye shot towards Liu Feng quickly. Liu Feng quickly lay down, and the wind blade whistled from above his head, bringing with it a gust of cool wind and hitting the trees behind him. The big tree squeaked twice, and then moved away.

Liu Feng's eyes widened. Special power????Warcraft?????

Get up, turn around and run, damn, this world is too dangerous, but the earth is still safe....

Wind Leopard saw Liu Feng escaping but was not in a hurry. He lowered his head and kept gathering wind elements in his mouth. He raised his head fiercely and fired a large wind blade at Liu Feng who was rolling and crawling.

Feeling the strong wind coming from behind, Liu Feng did not dare to look back and ran as fast as he could, but no matter how fast his legs were, they could not move faster than the wind. The wind blade behind him was getting closer and closer. Liu Feng had already heard the howling wind behind him. Suddenly, his back felt cold and his clothes were torn.

At the critical moment of life and death, Liu Feng's mind went blank. The world seemed to have become quiet, and the whistling behind him also stopped. Suddenly something seemed to well up from the depths of his mind, and it seemed to start automatically?

Wind Leopard proudly looked at his masterpiece, which was its most powerful move, "Storm Blade".This magic is comparable to human level four magic.

"Storm Blade" was getting closer and closer to the target, and a cruel smile appeared on the corner of Feng Leopard's mouth.

It was getting closer, getting closer, and just when the "Storm Blade" was about to tear the target into pieces, the prey suddenly disappeared. Disappeared?

Feng Bao looked at this bizarre situation and shook his head in confusion. Has my magic been upgraded?The power became stronger, tearing that human into powder?

But there was no answer. Feng Bao, who was not very intelligent, had to attribute this mistake to the reason why magic suddenly became stronger. As for why it became stronger, it was probably because the human was too ugly and too arrogant, which made the wind element hate him extremely. Whatever, he would die anyway, so go back and continue sleeping.

It is said that something in Liu Feng's mind was activated at that time, and then he felt that the surrounding scene seemed to become blurred, and the strong wind kept hitting his cheeks "whooshing". This seemed to be a symbol of high-speed movement?

Suddenly, Liu Feng woke up. He was indeed running at high speed, but how could I run so fast?

Suddenly, a giant tree appeared a hundred meters ahead. Although he didn't know what would happen if he hit it at his current speed, Liu Feng's scalp went numb just thinking about the cars that collided on the highway on Earth.

"Stop... vomit... vomit. Go down..." Liu Feng opened his mouth and was filled with strong wind. He could only roar in his heart: "Stop, stop quickly, I'm going to fuck your mother, stop it, my labor and management don't want to die."

There are still 50 meters away from the giant tree...40...20...10...

Liu Feng's eyes widened, and a look of horror filled his face. When he was still about 5 meters away from the big tree, Liu Feng's body suddenly paused, but due to the inertia brought by the extremely high speed, his body fell to the ground, and he was hit several times in succession.He rolled, and then hit his head on a tree trunk. His head hurt, his vision went dark, and he fainted. The last thought in Liu Feng's mind the moment before he fell into coma was, "God, the Jade Emperor, the Tathagata Buddha, I will fuck your immortal board."

Not long after Liu Feng fell into coma, the sound of "Clear Shuttle" footsteps could be heard not far from the jungle, and then, a voice as light and crisp as a wind chime sounded: "Grandpa, hurry up, the fluctuation of the wind element just now was here."

"Haha, don't worry, dear grandson, my body and bones are not as strong as yours, old man." An old voice rang out right after.

As the branches swayed, a delicate little face appeared behind the green leaves. The beautiful big blue eyes were like two sapphires, flashing mischievously, and the long eyelashes flickered.

I saw her jumping out from behind the branch, curiously looking at Liu Feng lying on the ground not far away, turning her head and shouting softly behind her: "Grandpa, come quickly, there is a person here, but I don't know whether he is dead or alive."

An old man appeared behind the girl, with a smile on his face. He smiled at the girl and said, "Let's go over and take a look."

"Ah, Grandpa, look at him covered in blood." The girl covered her mouth and exclaimed in surprise.

The old man frowned, looked at Liu Feng's wound, and said, "The wound was caused by the wind. I think the wind element fluctuation just now is probably related to him, but there is no fighting spirit or magic fluctuation in his body?"

"Haha, grandpa is so stupid. Since he has no fighting spirit and magic, and he has so many wounds caused by wind blades, he might have encountered a wind monster in the forest of death." The girl wrinkled her cute little nose and smiled coquettishly at the old man.

"Haha, your good granddaughter is so smart." The old man said with a big smile.

"Of course, I am a saint student of Xinglan Academy." The girl said proudly, puffing out her chest.

Hearing the name of Xinglan Academy, the old man squinted his eyes and smiled, looking at the girl with a little more relief.

"What should we do? Grandpa" the girl asked with her rosy mouth pouting.

The old man thought for a while and said to the girl: "Well, let's take him home first. If we just leave him here like this, he won't survive tonight."

"Grandpa is so kind-hearted." The girl's big blue eyes curved into beautiful crescents.

"Haha, haha." Hearing the girl's flattery, the old man laughed happily. The deep wrinkles on his forehead also opened up a lot, and he seemed to be younger......
